description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotence of the request. The value of this parameter must be unique among different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

descriptions.zh:
> - 为了保障您数据的安全性，建议开启HTTPS协议。
- 除8.5版本、7.16版本<props="china"><ph>和部分地域的7.10版本</ph></props>外，开启HTTPS前请确保您已购买协调节点。
descriptions.en:
> - To ensure data security, enable the HTTPS protocol.
- Except for versions 8.5 and 7.16<props="china"><ph> and version 7.10 in some regions</ph></props>, make sure that you have purchased client nodes before enabling HTTPS.
